description:
🚀 MissionMint is a creative space-mission design game built for the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge.

Players design spacecraft, choose scientific instruments, manage resources such as mass, power, budget, and communications, and make decisions that affect mission success.

MissionMint combines space science, game development, AI, interactive visualization, and storytelling to make space-mission engineering fun and easy to explore.

🌙 Design the mission. 🛰️ Make the decisions. 🚀 Explore beyond.
